Express Funded Account™ Parameters

Pass the Trading Combine. Pick your path. Start earning.

Updated over 3 weeks ago
The Basics

You passed the Trading Combine®. Now it's time to trade for real Payouts. The Express Funded Account® (XFA) is the simulated funded-level account you earn after passing your Trading Combine. Your balance starts at $0 and grows from your trading profits.You can hold up to 5 active XFAs at a time. At activation, you choose your Payout path: Standard or Consistency.

🤜 The XFA is the proving ground. Put in the reps, prove your strategy is consistent, and earn your call-up to the big leagues. Trade with discipline, hit your Payouts, and build the track record that gets you to Live. 

📺 Check out this quick video to learn about the Express Funded Account:

Express Funded Account Standard 

Rule

Do not hit your Maximum Loss Limit

Objectives

Follow the Scaling Plan — the max contracts you can hold at one time — based on your current account balance.

Hit 5 winning days with at least $150 profit each

If you’ve chosen to add a Daily Loss Limit, you must stay within the limits each day.

Express Funded Account Consistency

Rule

Do not hit your Maximum Loss Limit

Objectives

Follow the Scaling Plan — the max contracts you can hold at one time — based on your current account balance.

Trade at least 3 days with at least 1 trade per day

Keep your consistency at 40% or below: 

Consistency = Largest Winning Day ÷ Total Net Profit

If you’ve chosen to add a Daily Loss Limit, you must stay within the limits each day.

 XFA Consistency FAQs

 

What is XFA Consistency?

An alternative Payout path that rewards balanced trading. Instead of 5 winning days, you need 3 trading days. But no single day can make up more than 40% of your total profits. Consistency is reset after each Payout.


​How is consistency calculated?
👉 Consistency = Largest Winning Day ÷ Total Net Profit

 


Consistency tracking only appears on your dashboard once you have positive net profit. If your balance is negative, build profit first. Consistency is calculated for each payout window. Once you request a payout, it resets.

Example: 

Total profit $1,000, best day $400 = 40% ✅. 

Best day $450 = 45% ❌. 

Keep trading to bring that percentage down.

Why does the Consistency Objective exist?
To reward traders who make money regularly, not just on one big day. Discipline over time beats one lucky session.

 

Can I have a mix of Standard and Consistency XFA accounts?
Yes, up to the 5-account limit, unless you're on the Focused Trader Plan (FTP).

 

How does a Payout affect my Consistency?
Your consistency calculation resets after each Payout and applies only to profits earned afterward. Payout eligibility must be met again from scratch.

 

Example: You earn $15,000 over 3 days ($5,000 each = 33% consistency ✅) and take a $5,000 Payout. Your remaining balance is $10,000, but your consistency clock resets. You now need 3 new qualifying days on profits earned after that Payout.

 

Express Funded Account FAQs

 

 Can I have more than 1 XFA?


Yes, up to 5 active at a time. If you pass a Trading Combine® while at the limit, the new XFA goes on hold until one closes. Shoulder Tap account holders are limited to 1 XFA.

 

What happens if I breach the Maximum Loss Limit?


Your account is liquidated and closed at the end of the day. Back2Funded lets you reactivate up to 2 times at the same size and Payout policy.

 

 Can I mix account sizes?


Yes. Example: two 50K XFAs and three 150K XFAs. 

 

 Can I change my XFA size or type?


No. Your size matches the Trading Combine® you passed and is locked before and after activation. Once you select XFA Consistency or Standard, that choice cannot be changed either.

 

 Why does my XFA show a $0 balance?


This is expected. Your buying power is still the full account size (50K, 100K, or 150K). Your balance grows as you earn profits.

 

 What are the fees?


No monthly subscription fee after passing. A one-time Activation Fee applies per XFA (Unless you chose the No Activation Fee Trading Combine). See Topstep Pricing for current rates.

 

 Do I need a data subscription?


No. Level 1 (Top of Book) data is included with your Topstep membership. Level 2 (Depth of Market) is available as an upgrade. See Level 1 and Level 2 Market Data.

 

 How long does it take to get my XFA?


Minutes after paying the Activation Fee. If you pass on a Friday, your XFA won't be available until markets reopen at 5 PM CT Sunday.

 

 What happens if I go inactive?


XFAs with no trading activity for more than 30 days may be closed. XFAs can't be put on hold.

 

 How do Payouts work on a simulated account?


Topstep pays you real money based on your simulated trading results. See the Payout Policy for how to qualify and request.

 

 Can I get called up to a Live Funded Account?


That's the goal — the call-up. The Risk Team is watching your tape. Keep trading consistently and let your performance make the case. Learn more here.

 

 Can I use automated strategies?


Yes, with conditions. Topstep won't help set them up or cover malfunctions. Review Prohibited Conduct and Prohibited Trading Strategies first.

 

 Can I trade across multiple XFAs at once?


Yes, up to $750K buying power using a trade copier. See What is a Trade Copier. Hedging across accounts and coordinated trading with others is prohibited. See Understanding Hedging and Topstep's Terms of Use.

Live Funded Account Parameters

The XFA proved you belong here. Live is where it counts — real capital, real markets, no ceiling on what you can earn.

Updated over a week ago
The Basics

Real capital. Real markets. The Live Funded Account® (LFA) is the big leagues — Topstep's money behind you, no Payout caps, and unlimited growth potential. When the call-up comes, all Express Funded Accounts (XFA) close. This is what you've been working toward.

Live Account Size

Your LFA size is based on the average account size (the funded tier of each XFA — $50K, $100K, or $150K — not the current balance) of all active, eligible XFAs with at least 1 Payout. If you haven't requested any Payouts yet, all XFAs are averaged together. The average is rounded up to the nearest tier ($50K, $100K, or $150K).

 

Example: Four 50K XFAs + one 150K XFA = 70K average → rounds up to $100K LFA.

Starting Balance and Reserve

Two numbers set your Live starting balance:

Account Size — the average of your eligible XFAs, rounded up to the nearest tier. This is a hard cap ($25K, $50K, $100K, $150K, or $250K)

Cumulative balance — the actual balances in those XFAs, added together. Remember: what transfers is capped at the account size. 

What transfers then splits:

20% available to trade immediately — minimum $10,000*

80% held in Reserve — released in 4 increments of 25% as you hit profit thresholds

*Except the $25K Live Funded Account, which has a minimum starting balance of $5,000

Example: Four $50K XFAs holding $25K each. Account Size = $50K. Cumulative balance was $100K, so $50K is forfeited. → $10K to trade, $40K in Reserve.

👉  Heads up: all Express Funded Accounts are averaged together, so new Topstep Labs accounts may affect your account size.

Capital Expansion — Unlocking Your Reserve

Reserve funds unlock in 25% increments each time you hit the Profit Target for your LFA size. The Profit Target mirrors your Trading Combine® profit target:

LFA Size

	

Profit Target to Unlock Reserve Increment




$25K

$50K

$100K

$150K

$250K

	

$15,000

 

Capital Expansion is: 

Reviewed every Monday morning

Funds deposited within 1-2 business days

Can be delayed or denied for excessive or reckless risk behavior

You cannot unlock multiple tiers with a single large win — each threshold requires net profit since the last expansion.

Important: If your LFA balance drops below $1,000, the account may be immediately liquidated and closed at end of the trading day. The remaining balance would then be sent as a final Payout.
​
​Example: Account drops to $800 = auto liquidation and account closure at the end of that day. The remaining $800 is sent as a final Payout. Unlocked reserve is forfeited. 

Daily Loss Limit and Maximum Position Size

Maximum Position Size: The maximum number of contracts you can hold open at one time, per account. Your Maximum Position Size is affected by your performance in the Live Funded Account. Learn more here: Dynamic Live Risk Expansion

Live Funded Accounts start with a Daily Loss Limit (DLL) based on account size:

☝️ When limits change:

Decreases: Any day of the week, usually by end of day (EOD).

Increases: Fridays only. If your balance rose above a threshold that week, your DLL and Maximum Position Size are raised back up.

Example: Your balance drops below a threshold on Tuesday. Your limits are lowered that day. Your balance recovers on Wednesday. Your limits stay lower until Friday.

Shoulder Tap Express Funded Account

A Shoulder Tap XFA is a simulated funded account created after a call down from Live. Part of the LFA risk framework — a structured path back to Live trading if needed. Call-back is discretionary, based on overall trading behavior. Learn more →

Live Funded Account FAQs
 Can I decline the invitation to move to Live and stay in my XFA?

 

 How long does it take to create a Live Funded Account?

 

 How is my Live Funded Account size determined if I haven't received any Payouts yet?

 

 Can I have more than one Live Funded Account?

 

 If I lose my LFA, can I go straight back to an XFA without a Trading Combine?

 

 Can I take Payouts before unlocking all my Reserve?

 

 How do I request a Payout?

 

 Is the live trading capital my money?

 

 Can I unlock multiple Reserve tiers at once with a big win?

 

 Can I use automated strategies in my LFA?

 

 How does trading Live benefit me over SIM?

 

 Once I have 30 winning days, can I take a 100% payout?

 

 What happens if my Live account closes? 

 

 What happens if I lose my 20% starting balance? 

 

 What happens if I go inactive? 

 

 Can I have Trading Combines while I have a Live Funded Account?

 

Tip: You can duplicate trades across multiple accounts using a trade copier. Learn more here.

Live Funded Account Parameters

The XFA proved you belong here. Live is where it counts — real capital, real markets, no ceiling on what you can earn.

Updated over a week ago
The Basics

Real capital. Real markets. The Live Funded Account® (LFA) is the big leagues — Topstep's money behind you, no Payout caps, and unlimited growth potential. When the call-up comes, all Express Funded Accounts (XFA) close. This is what you've been working toward.

Live Account Size

Your LFA size is based on the average account size (the funded tier of each XFA — $50K, $100K, or $150K — not the current balance) of all active, eligible XFAs with at least 1 Payout. If you haven't requested any Payouts yet, all XFAs are averaged together. The average is rounded up to the nearest tier ($50K, $100K, or $150K).

 

Example: Four 50K XFAs + one 150K XFA = 70K average → rounds up to $100K LFA.

Starting Balance and Reserve

Two numbers set your Live starting balance:

Account Size — the average of your eligible XFAs, rounded up to the nearest tier. This is a hard cap ($25K, $50K, $100K, $150K, or $250K)

Cumulative balance — the actual balances in those XFAs, added together. Remember: what transfers is capped at the account size. 

What transfers then splits:

20% available to trade immediately — minimum $10,000*

80% held in Reserve — released in 4 increments of 25% as you hit profit thresholds

*Except the $25K Live Funded Account, which has a minimum starting balance of $5,000

Example: Four $50K XFAs holding $25K each. Account Size = $50K. Cumulative balance was $100K, so $50K is forfeited. → $10K to trade, $40K in Reserve.

👉  Heads up: all Express Funded Accounts are averaged together, so new Topstep Labs accounts may affect your account size.

Capital Expansion — Unlocking Your Reserve

Reserve funds unlock in 25% increments each time you hit the Profit Target for your LFA size. The Profit Target mirrors your Trading Combine® profit target:

Profit Target to Unlock Reserve Increment

$50K

$100K

$150K

	

$9,000




$250K

	

$15,000

 

Capital Expansion is: 

Reviewed every Monday morning

Funds deposited within 1-2 business days

Can be delayed or denied for excessive or reckless risk behavior

You cannot unlock multiple tiers with a single large win — each threshold requires net profit since the last expansion.

Important: If your LFA balance drops below $1,000, the account may be immediately liquidated and closed at end of the trading day. The remaining balance would then be sent as a final Payout.
​
​Example: Account drops to $800 = auto liquidation and account closure at the end of that day. The remaining $800 is sent as a final Payout. Unlocked reserve is forfeited. 

Daily Loss Limit and Maximum Position Size

Maximum Position Size: The maximum number of contracts you can hold open at one time, per account. Your Maximum Position Size is affected by your performance in the Live Funded Account. Learn more here: Dynamic Live Risk Expansion

Live Funded Accounts start with a Daily Loss Limit (DLL) based on account size:

Regardless of account size, if your tradable balance drops to lower thresholds, the DLL and Maximum Position Size automatically adjust:

Tradable Balance

	

DLL

	

Max Position Size




$10,000 or below

	

$2,000

	

5




$5,000 or below

	

$1,000

	

3

☝️ When limits change:

Decreases: Any day of the week, usually by end of day (EOD).

Increases: Fridays only. If your balance rose above a threshold that week, your DLL and Maximum Position Size are raised back up.

Example: Your balance drops below a threshold on Tuesday. Your limits are lowered that day. Your balance recovers on Wednesday. Your limits stay lower until Friday.

Shoulder Tap Express Funded Account

A Shoulder Tap XFA is a simulated funded account created after a call down from Live. Part of the LFA risk framework — a structured path back to Live trading if needed. Call-back is discretionary, based on overall trading behavior. Learn more →
